theory_basis: Ordinary least squares with classical inference
primary_reference: Aitken (1936), On Least Squares and Linear Combination of Observations
validation_evidence: NumPy closed-form oracle; deterministic Python-Stata-R pilot covering constant and no-constant cases
stata_parity: Result layer passed after stable-tail p-value repair; independent code and theory audits remain pending
known_risks: Classical inference depends on model assumptions; inverse-based fitting is fragile for singular or nearly singular designs; robust covariance is not implemented
safeguards: Complete-case preparation; explicit intercept option; frozen dataset hash; zero-underflow safety rule; three-engine pairwise comparison
release_gate: Promote to Stable only after exact primary-source mappings for all fit statistics, independent code/theory audits, and an immutable clean-run attestation pass

theory_basis: Linear regression after absorbing one or more high-dimensional fixed effects
primary_reference: Correia (2017), A Feasible Estimator for Linear Models with Multi-Way Fixed Effects
validation_evidence: NumPy within-transformation oracle; six Stata comparison cases; robust and clustered VCE cases
known_risks: Iterative partialling-out can fail to converge; singleton handling and absorbed degrees of freedom affect inference
safeguards: Tolerance and iteration cap are public; singleton removal; explicit VCE validation
release_gate: Require convergence tests, singleton/collinearity cases, and exact Stata parity for each supported VCE before release

theory_basis: Regression quantiles estimated by minimizing asymmetric absolute loss
primary_reference: Koenker and Bassett (1978), Regression Quantiles
validation_evidence: Hard-coded Stata coefficient checks and optimizer tests; VCE checks use relaxed tolerance
stata_parity: Partial: coefficients covered; inference parity is less strict
known_risks: Sparse-density and bandwidth estimation make standard errors sensitive; optimizer behavior can change across SciPy versions
safeguards: Quantile range validation; convergence result; explicit sparsity and bandwidth outputs
release_gate: Promote to Stable after dense quantile grid, tied outcomes, small samples, and Stata VCE parity pass strict tolerances

theory_basis: Within estimator for unit fixed effects
primary_reference: Mundlak (1978), On the Pooling of Time Series and Cross Section Data
validation_evidence: Manual/NumPy oracle plus Stata nlswork comparison
stata_parity: Verified: coefficients, SE, variance components, and fit statistics within tolerance
known_risks: Time-invariant regressors are unidentified; unbalanced panels and singleton groups require care
safeguards: Panel identifier required; complete-case preparation; explicit model dispatch
release_gate: Keep Stable only with balanced/unbalanced, singleton, collinearity, and Stata parity tests

theory_basis: Random-effects generalized least squares
primary_reference: Mundlak (1978), On the Pooling of Time Series and Cross Section Data
validation_evidence: Manual/NumPy oracle plus Stata nlswork comparison
known_risks: Consistency requires unit effects to be uncorrelated with regressors
safeguards: Panel identifier required; reports sigma_u, sigma_e, rho, and theta
release_gate: Keep Stable only with variance-component boundary and unbalanced-panel tests

theory_basis: Between estimator on group means
primary_reference: Mundlak (1978), On the Pooling of Time Series and Cross Section Data
validation_evidence: Manual/NumPy oracle plus Stata nlswork comparison
stata_parity: Verified: coefficient, SE, F statistic, and group-count parity
known_risks: Uses only between-unit variation and can be inefficient or misleading for within-unit questions
safeguards: Panel identifier required; group aggregation is explicit
release_gate: Keep Stable only with unequal group sizes and missing-within-group tests

theory_basis: Gaussian random-effects maximum likelihood
primary_reference: Mundlak (1978), On the Pooling of Time Series and Cross Section Data
validation_evidence: Numerical likelihood tests plus Stata nlswork comparison
stata_parity: Verified: coefficients, SE, likelihood, and variance components within tolerance
known_risks: Local optimization and variance parameters near zero can make Hessian inference fragile
safeguards: Convergence state and variance components are exposed
release_gate: Require failed-convergence tests and boundary-variance simulations before each major release

theory_basis: Population-averaged estimation using iterative GEE-style updates
primary_reference: Liang and Zeger (1986), Longitudinal Data Analysis Using Generalized Linear Models
validation_evidence: Manual tests and Stata nlswork comparison
stata_parity: Partial: known approximately 0.02% Wald-statistic difference; phi not reported
known_risks: Iterative convergence and working-correlation choices can affect estimates and inference
safeguards: Iteration tolerance; group identifier; robust covariance tests
release_gate: Promote after phi output and strict parity for coefficients, covariance, and Wald statistic

theory_basis: Binary-response maximum likelihood with normal link
primary_reference: Bliss (1934), The Method of Probits
validation_evidence: SciPy likelihood/oracle tests; Stata comparison workflow
known_risks: Complete or quasi-complete separation can cause divergence; marginal effects are not yet part of this feature
safeguards: Binary outcome validation; convergence tolerance and maximum iterations
release_gate: Add explicit separation warnings and multi-dataset Stata parity before Evidence A

theory_basis: Binary-response maximum likelihood with logistic link
primary_reference: Berkson (1944), Application of the Logistic Function to Bio-Assay
validation_evidence: SciPy likelihood/oracle tests and Stata comparison
known_risks: Complete or quasi-complete separation can cause divergent coefficients
safeguards: Stable logistic transform; binary outcome validation; convergence controls
release_gate: Keep Stable only with separation, rare-event, and extreme-linear-predictor tests

theory_basis: Ordered latent-variable model with normal link and estimated cut points
primary_reference: McKelvey and Zavoina (1975), A Statistical Model for the Analysis of Ordinal Level Dependent Variables
validation_evidence: SciPy optimizer/oracle tests and threshold-order tests
known_risks: Sparse outcome categories and nearly equal cut points can produce weak identification or optimizer failure
safeguards: Sorted categories; transformed cut points; convergence state
release_gate: Promote after Stata coefficient, cut-point, covariance, and prediction parity on at least three datasets

theory_basis: Ordered cumulative logit model with estimated cut points
primary_reference: McCullagh (1980), Regression Models for Ordinal Data
validation_evidence: SciPy optimizer/oracle tests and threshold-order tests
known_risks: Proportional-odds assumption is substantive; sparse categories can destabilize thresholds
safeguards: Sorted categories; transformed cut points; convergence state
release_gate: Promote after proportional-odds diagnostics and Stata parity for parameters and covariance

theory_basis: Generalized linear models fitted by iteratively reweighted least squares
primary_reference: Nelder and Wedderburn (1972), Generalized Linear Models
validation_evidence: Independent NumPy IRLS oracle for supported family/link combinations
known_risks: Invalid family-link combinations, boundary means, and overflow can invalidate IRLS inference
safeguards: Supported family/link whitelist; convergence controls; stable link calculations
release_gate: Add Stata parity for every advertised family/link pair and boundary-case simulations before Evidence A

theory_basis: Multinomial logistic maximum likelihood relative to a base outcome
primary_reference: McFadden (1974), Conditional Logit Analysis of Qualitative Choice Behavior
validation_evidence: Independent SciPy likelihood/oracle tests, base-category and shape tests
known_risks: Independence-of-irrelevant-alternatives is a model assumption; rare categories and separation can destabilize estimates
safeguards: Explicit base outcome; stable probability normalization; convergence state
release_gate: Add Stata parity, separation warnings, and category-permutation invariance before Evidence A

theory_basis: Sample-selection model by full-information MLE or two-step correction
primary_reference: Heckman (1979), Sample Selection Bias as a Specification Error
validation_evidence: SciPy oracle tests and hard-coded Stata benchmark cases
stata_parity: Partial: benchmark values exist but no current .verify report
known_risks: Identification can rely only on distributional assumptions without an exclusion restriction; rho near boundaries causes numerical fragility
safeguards: Supports MLE and two-step; convergence state; selected/nonselected counts
release_gate: Require explicit exclusion-restriction guidance, rho-boundary tests, and reproducible Stata report before Stable

theory_basis: Censored-normal maximum likelihood
primary_reference: Tobin (1958), Estimation of Relationships for Limited Dependent Variables
validation_evidence: SciPy oracle tests exist; repository verification report records standard-error mismatches and requires re-verification after later code changes
stata_parity: Failed/stale evidence: .verify/reports/tobit.md reports SE differences of roughly 40-97%
known_risks: Inference may be wrong even when coefficients and likelihood match; numerical Hessian is scale-sensitive
safeguards: Censor-limit validation; convergence state; robust VCE option in current code
release_gate: Do not promote until a fresh Stata run proves coefficient, covariance, likelihood, censor counts, and robust VCE parity on scaled and unscaled data

theory_basis: Linear instrumental-variables estimation by two-stage least squares
primary_reference: Anderson and Rubin (1949), Estimation of the Parameters of a Single Equation in a Complete System of Stochastic Equations
validation_evidence: Independent NumPy oracle plus Stata unadjusted and robust comparisons
known_risks: Weak or invalid instruments can make estimates misleading even when software is numerically correct
safeguards: Underidentification check; robust/cluster VCE validation; first-stage diagnostics exposed
release_gate: Keep Stable only with weak-instrument simulation and exact diagnostic-definition tests

theory_basis: Efficient linear GMM based on orthogonality conditions
primary_reference: Hansen (1982), Large Sample Properties of Generalized Method of Moments Estimators
validation_evidence: NumPy oracle and Stata coefficient/covariance comparison
stata_parity: Verified: GMM discrepancies fixed; current report passes
known_risks: Weight-matrix conditioning and few clusters can invalidate finite-sample inference
safeguards: Identification check; robust covariance; J statistic exposed
release_gate: Keep Stable only with singular/near-singular instruments, just-identification, and overidentification tests

theory_basis: Limited-information maximum likelihood represented as a k-class estimator
primary_reference: Anderson and Rubin (1949), Estimation of the Parameters of a Single Equation in a Complete System of Stochastic Equations
validation_evidence: Eigenvalue/oracle tests and Stata coefficient, covariance, and kappa comparison
known_risks: Near-singular systems and weak instruments can make kappa and coefficients unstable
safeguards: Underidentification check; kappa exposed; matrix-conditioning tests
release_gate: Keep Stable only with weak-instrument and eigenvalue-degeneracy fixtures

theory_basis: Additional GMM and k-class estimators
primary_reference: Hansen, Heaton, and Yaron (1996), Finite-Sample Properties of Some Alternative GMM Estimators
validation_evidence: Unit and oracle tests cover estimator dispatch and selected numerical cases
stata_parity: No complete Stata parity matrix for all three variants
known_risks: CUE optimization can have local minima; user-supplied k and Fuller correction are sensitive under weak identification
safeguards: Estimator whitelist; explicit k/fuller parameters; convergence and matrix checks
release_gate: Promote estimator by estimator only after independent oracle and Stata parity for coefficients, covariance, and diagnostics

theory_basis: Identification, weak-instrument, overidentification, and endogeneity diagnostics
primary_reference: Kleibergen and Paap (2006), Generalized Reduced Rank Tests Using the Singular Value Decomposition
validation_evidence: Dedicated KP tests exist but include very loose tolerances; ivreghdfe report records materially wrong or missing diagnostics
stata_parity: Failed for HDFE path; partial for ordinary IV
known_risks: A misdefined diagnostic can falsely reassure users about identification and is a high scientific-safety risk
safeguards: Diagnostic fields are explicit and can be withheld; underidentification count check runs before estimation
release_gate: Do not label KP diagnostics production-ready until formula-level oracle tests and Stata parity pass under robust, clustered, and HDFE cases

theory_basis: Endogenous-regressor probit by MLE or two-step control-function estimator
primary_reference: Newey (1987), Efficient Estimation of Limited Dependent Variable Models with Endogenous Explanatory Variables
validation_evidence: Twenty-one Stata comparisons across MLE, robust MLE, and two-step
known_risks: Weak instruments, separation, and rho near its boundary can cause nonstandard numerical behavior
safeguards: Underidentification check; convergence state; robust VCE option; endogeneity test exposed
release_gate: Keep Stable only with weak-instrument, separation, multi-endogenous, and failed-convergence fixtures

theory_basis: Endogenous-regressor censored-normal model by MLE or two-step control function
primary_reference: Blundell and Smith (1986), An Exogeneity Test for a Simultaneous Equation Tobit Model with an Application to Labor Supply
validation_evidence: Unit tests exist; repository Stata report records convergence to a different solution and large coefficient/inference differences
known_risks: Wrong local optimum or likelihood implementation can produce substantively false results; test fixture itself includes Stata non-convergence
safeguards: Underidentification and censor-limit checks; convergence state; robust VCE option
release_gate: Block Stable/Beta promotion until converged reference datasets show likelihood, parameters, covariance, censor counts, and endogeneity-test parity

theory_basis: Instrumental variables after high-dimensional fixed-effect absorption
primary_reference: Correia (2017), A Feasible Estimator for Linear Models with Multi-Way Fixed Effects
validation_evidence: Unit tests exist; repository Stata report records missing/wrong diagnostics, fit-statistic differences, and a clustered multi-absorb crash
known_risks: Known crash and incorrect weak-identification statistic are release-blocking scientific-safety defects
safeguards: Underidentification check; iteration tolerance; explicit VCE and clustering options
release_gate: Do not recommend for research inference until every unchecked item in the verification report is fixed and re-run

theory_basis: Deterministic column expressions and conditional replacement
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Expression-engine unit tests and Stata-style workflow tests
known_risks: Expression parsing errors or silent type coercion can change the analysis sample
safeguards: Restricted expression engine; explicit replace behavior; exceptions on invalid expressions
release_gate: Keep Stable only with injection-safety, missing-value, boolean precedence, and dtype regression tests

theory_basis: Grouped and row-wise derived variables
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Unit tests for supported aggregations and group behavior
known_risks: Group keys containing missing values and dtype coercion can produce unexpected sample changes
safeguards: Explicit function whitelist and group columns
release_gate: Add a parity fixture for every supported egen function before extending the whitelist

theory_basis: Deterministic schema manipulation
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Unit and README workflow tests
known_risks: Destructive in-memory selection can discard variables needed later
safeguards: Explicit variable lists; missing-column errors; operations are limited to the wrapped DataFrame
release_gate: Require copy/aliasing and missing-column tests; document that callers should preserve raw data

theory_basis: Quantile-based tail replacement
primary_reference: Engineering transformation; substantive use must be justified by the research design
validation_evidence: Unit tests for cuts, grouping, and replacement/generate modes
known_risks: Winsorization changes the estimand and can hide data errors; grouped quantiles may be unstable in small groups
safeguards: Requires explicit cuts; supports generated output; preserves original when requested
release_gate: Remain Beta; require an explicit user-facing warning and provenance metadata before Stable

theory_basis: Deterministic wide/long reshaping
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Round-trip and Stata-style reshape tests
known_risks: Non-unique identifiers can duplicate or aggregate rows unexpectedly
safeguards: Identifier and stub validation; duplicate detection
release_gate: Keep Stable only with wide-long-wide round-trip invariants and non-unique-key failure tests

theory_basis: Grouped aggregation
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Aggregation and group tests
known_risks: Aggregation is intentionally lossy and can change weights or sample interpretation
safeguards: Explicit aggregation specification and grouping variables
release_gate: Require deterministic column order, missing-value policy, and aggregation whitelist tests

theory_basis: Duplicate tagging, listing, and removal
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Duplicate-mode tests
known_risks: Dropping duplicates without a complete key can remove valid observations
safeguards: Explicit subset and action parameters; deterministic keep policy
release_gate: Keep Stable only with missing-key, stable-order, and all duplicate-mode tests

theory_basis: Relational joins and row concatenation
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Merge cardinality, indicator, append, and Stata comparison tests
known_risks: Many-to-many joins can multiply rows and contaminate results; dtype mismatch can silently miss keys
safeguards: Merge validation and indicator support; explicit join keys
release_gate: Require one-to-one/one-to-many cardinality assertions, row-count audit, and dtype mismatch tests

theory_basis: Stable ascending/descending ordering
primary_reference: Engineering semantics; no research paper required
validation_evidence: Ordering and mixed-direction tests
known_risks: Sort stability affects tie order and subsequent first/last operations
safeguards: Stable sort behavior and explicit direction parsing
release_gate: Keep Stable only with tie-order, missing-value, and multi-key tests

public_api: tab.data.sum / describe / count / head / search / list_var
theory_basis: Descriptive summaries and schema inspection
primary_reference: Standard descriptive-statistics definitions
validation_evidence: Unit tests for counts, summaries, percentiles, skewness, and kurtosis
known_risks: Different missing-value conventions and degrees of freedom can change reported summaries
safeguards: Observation counts are exposed; result objects preserve variable names
release_gate: Require explicit missing-value and sample-standard-deviation conventions in docs and tests

theory_basis: Pearson/Spearman correlation using explicit missing-data handling
primary_reference: Pearson product-moment and Spearman rank correlation definitions
validation_evidence: Independent numerical tests and Stata comparison
known_risks: Pairwise versus listwise deletion can change both values and effective sample size
safeguards: Method validation; n_obs exposed; missing-data behavior tested
release_gate: Keep Stable only while correlation values and sample counts match documented deletion semantics

theory_basis: Sample covariance matrix
primary_reference: Standard sample-covariance definition
validation_evidence: Independent numerical tests and Stata comparison
known_risks: Degrees of freedom and missing-data policy affect covariance values
safeguards: n_obs exposed; numerical tests cover matrix shape and values
release_gate: Keep Stable only with singular, constant-column, and missing-data parity tests

theory_basis: One-way and two-way frequency tables with percentages
primary_reference: Contingency-table definitions
validation_evidence: Crosstab result-object and formatting tests
known_risks: Category ordering, missing categories, and denominator choices affect percentages
safeguards: Row/column/cell percentages are separately exposed with counts
release_gate: Require explicit missing-category and zero-denominator behavior tests

theory_basis: Panel transition counts and probabilities
primary_reference: Finite-state transition-matrix definitions
validation_evidence: Transition count/probability and result-object tests
known_risks: Unsorted panels, time gaps, and duplicate time observations can create invalid transitions
safeguards: Uses configured panel/time keys; exposes counts and probabilities separately
release_gate: Require duplicate-time rejection, gap policy, sorting invariance, and missing-state tests

theory_basis: Standard descriptive graphics
primary_reference: Engineering visualization semantics; no estimator paper required
validation_evidence: Smoke, annotation, and plot-type tests
known_risks: Plots can hide missing data, aggregation choices, or overplotting and should not be treated as inferential evidence
safeguards: Explicit labels/titles; returns figure wrapper; save formats controlled
release_gate: Keep Stable with noninteractive backend, empty-data, missing-value, and deterministic-output smoke tests

theory_basis: OLS fit line and confidence interval for visualization
primary_reference: Ordinary least squares inference
validation_evidence: Independent plot-data and confidence-band tests
known_risks: A fitted line can be visually over-interpreted as causal; CI assumptions mirror OLS assumptions
safeguards: Labels and CI styling exposed; uses explicit x and y
release_gate: Require numerical band oracle and degenerate-x tests

theory_basis: Distribution summaries and kernel density estimation
primary_reference: Rosenblatt (1956), Remarks on Some Nonparametric Estimates of a Density Function
validation_evidence: Plot smoke tests plus dedicated KDE and box tests
known_risks: Bandwidth and outliers materially affect the visual message; density support can extend beyond observed support
safeguards: Explicit bandwidth and group options; deterministic backend tests
release_gate: Keep Stable with constant-variable, tiny-group, boundary-support, and bandwidth tests

theory_basis: Layered chart composition
primary_reference: Engineering visualization semantics
validation_evidence: Layer dispatch and README workflow tests
known_risks: Axes or scales from incompatible layers can mislead
safeguards: Layer types are whitelisted; one shared figure wrapper controls output
release_gate: Require incompatible-layer errors and legend/axis-order tests

theory_basis: Coefficient and confidence-interval plot from fitted result objects
primary_reference: Jann (2014), Plotting Regression Coefficients and Other Estimates
validation_evidence: Dedicated coefficient extraction, ordering, labeling, and plot tests
known_risks: Mixing confidence levels, transformed coefficients, or incompatible models can mislead
safeguards: Consumes typed result objects; confidence level and labels are explicit
release_gate: Require tests for omitted coefficients, multiple models, alternate confidence levels, and non-finite SE

theory_basis: Matrix heatmap with labels and annotations
primary_reference: Engineering visualization semantics
validation_evidence: Dedicated matrix, annotation, and label tests
known_risks: Color scaling and ordering can exaggerate differences
safeguards: Explicit color range, annotation, and variable labels
release_gate: Keep Stable with constant matrix, NaN, asymmetric matrix, and custom scale tests

theory_basis: Residual-versus-fitted diagnostic plot
primary_reference: OLS residual diagnostic convention
validation_evidence: Dedicated residual/fitted extraction and plot tests
known_risks: Visual patterns are diagnostic, not formal tests; unsupported result types may have different residual meanings
safeguards: Requires compatible result object; reference line and labels are explicit
release_gate: Promote after a formal compatibility matrix across every result type and non-finite residual tests

theory_basis: Figure lifecycle and deterministic export
primary_reference: Engineering semantics
validation_evidence: Save-format, DPI, blocking, and smoke tests
known_risks: Backend differences can change fonts, layout, and reproducibility across systems
safeguards: Central figure wrapper; explicit formats and DPI; close operation
release_gate: Keep Stable with headless CI export tests for every documented format

theory_basis: Typed statistical results and Stata-style presentation
primary_reference: Estimator-specific statistical definitions
validation_evidence: Property, formatting, save, and model-specific tests
stata_parity: Indirectly covered by estimator verification reports
known_risks: A correct coefficient with a mislabeled statistic or stale sample count is a scientific-safety defect
safeguards: Read-only-style accessors; variable names and command metadata preserved; typed subclasses
release_gate: Require every reported scalar and matrix to have an oracle test and no duplicated recomputation logic

public_api: tab.est stored current result / implicit coefplot input
theory_basis: Session-local result storage and retrieval
primary_reference: Engineering semantics
validation_evidence: Accessor, overwrite, and README workflow tests
known_risks: Implicit current-result state can plot or save the wrong model after another estimation
safeguards: Centralized store; command metadata; explicit result arguments remain available
release_gate: Add named-result storage and show the active command prominently before multi-model workflows

theory_basis: Wrap an existing pandas DataFrame without hidden external I/O
primary_reference: Engineering semantics
validation_evidence: API, smoke, and README workflow tests
known_risks: Aliasing versus copying the input frame can surprise users and affect reproducibility
safeguards: Narrow DataFrame-only boundary; display style and result-display behavior are explicit
release_gate: Document copy semantics and test mutation isolation before expanding to file/network readers
